selection: All raw cEEGrid SET/FDT recordings present in the two pinned repository trees. Exclude sourcedata and derivatives copies, PSG, other modalities and stimulus files. No signal-based sampling.
scope: All available records are acquired and qualified. Analysis exposure is counted separately; invalid or missing records remain in the denominator.

split.rules: Group all records for a source participant. Source-local identifiers are not proof of cross-dataset disjoint identity. Validation and test are unused subjects in the current local project; pretrained-model exposure is unknown. Sleep external subjects 001 and 003 were used in Experiment 002 and are flagged exposed. Never tune to external metrics.

continuity: Preserve native sample coordinates and channel order; no concatenation across recorded boundary/BAD annotations. Store zero-duration boundaries explicitly; model context may not cross them. Unrecorded clock gaps remain unknown.
database: SQLite curator catalog and derived evidence tables; immutable raw files remain external to SQLite. Original technical metadata retained separately from label-blind discovery arrays.
release: Source licenses and hashes retained. Database rows are source-local participant records, not a verified global person census. Clinical/semantic labels and physical Neurable acquisition are not established by this corpus.
